messages.raw: My woodcutting assistant has fallen quite ill! Do you think you could take over for him?

messages.context: Lumber_Jack 新手流程实测台词（第 3 条）
messages.raw: Cheers! Let me tell ya a little about what we're going to be doing.
messages.text: Cheers! Let me tell ya a little about what we're going to be doing.
messages.zh: 太好了! 让我简单说说我们接下来要做什么。

messages.raw: We will be §aForaging§f! As one of SkyBlock's core skills, Foraging involves cutting down lots of different types of trees!
messages.text: We will be Foraging! As one of SkyBlock's core skills, Foraging involves cutting down lots of different types of trees!
messages.zh: 我们要去伐木! 伐木是 SkyBlock 的核心技能之一,需要砍伐许多不同种类的树木!

segments.text: ! As one of SkyBlock's core skills, Foraging involves cutting down lots of different types of trees!

messages.context: Lumber_Jack 新手流程实测台词（第 5 条）
messages.raw: As you do this, you'll unlock various crafts and useful stat boosts that will help in other areas of your adventure.

messages.zh: 在这个过程中,你会解锁各种配方和实用的属性加成,它们也会在冒险的其他方面助你一臂之力。
